messages:
jules: noticed high ingestion on route `gizmo-prod` at ~11:22, our sampler fell back to drop and we lost visibility for ~6m. Anyone around?
infra-bot: ALERT: route=gizmo-prod request_log_ingest_rate=22000/min (threshold=8000) at 2026-03-22T11:22:10Z
priya: saw it. That client does heavy batch jobs. We should support a short-lived burst credit rather than forcing global drop.
marc: burst credits are fine, but we need to tie any temporary sampling increase to a redaction_profile and an estimated PII exposure delta. No blind raises.
jules: sketching a minimal policy:
```
{
  "route": "gizmo-prod",
  "burst_credits": 5000,
  "sampling_profile": "diagnostic|baseline|minimal",
  "redaction_profile": "hashing_v1|masking_v2",
  "ephemeral_inspect_secs": 600
}
```
priya: diagnostic sampling = 5% with full request/response capture, baseline = 0.5% with structured metadata only, minimal = 0.01% (headers only).
rachel: Console UX idea: when a route hits soft quota show a compact panel with actions: "Grant burst (minutes)", "Apply diagnostic profile (ops-only)", "Isolate route". Each action shows a privacy delta estimate and required approvals.
marc: propose we compute a PII exposure_estimate metric per-change: tokens_likely_pii * sample_fraction -> expected_exposed_tokens. Telemetry rule: if delta_exposed_tokens > 1000 require 2FA approve.
devx: how do we represent redaction confidence in logs? Suggest adding two fields to sampled event: redaction_profile and redaction_confidence (0.0-1.0). Low confidence should automatically redact payloads for inspect.
jules: agree. Example event envelope: 
```
{
  "event_id": "...",
  "route": "gizmo-prod",
  "redaction_profile": "hashing_v1",
  "redaction_confidence": "0.86",
  "payload_type": "req|resp",
  "payload": "... (maybe masked)"
}
```
priya: ops concern: we need an audit-safe CLI for granting bursts. CLI must require reason and link to ticket. Eg: `ri ops grant-burst --route=gizmo-prod --minutes=15 --reason=investigate-heap --ticket=INC-1234`. That should emit immutable audit entry.
infra-bot: AUDIT: actor=priya action=grant-burst route=gizmo-prod minutes=15 ticket=INC-1234 ts=2026-03-22T11:30:05Z
rachel: dashboard change: add a "privacy-risk" column next to sampling rate with a sparkline; clicking it shows top contributing pii tokens and the suggested redaction_profile. Also show last audit entries.
marc: ops rollout: (1) add burst_credit & sampling_profile support to request-logger API; (2) telemetry: add exposure_estimate and redaction_confidence; (3) console: action panel + approval modal; (4) gate diagnostic_profile behind canary (10 tenants) and ops-only flag.
jules: owners: priya -> request-logger changes, marc -> telemetry calc and gating, rachel -> console UX, devx -> CLI + audit hook. Can we get a quick follow-up PRs list?
devx: will open PRs for CLI and audit sink today. I'll include tests that assert audit entries are immutable.
priya: I'll prototype sampling_profile endpoints; will include backward compat defaults so older routes keep current behavior.
rachel: I'll mock the panel and approval modal, include copy for the privacy-delta tooltip. Posting Figma link in ~24h.
marc: one more: add a passive telemetry alert that correlates "increase in diagnostic captures" with "spike in pii redaction failures" over 5m and auto-suggest isolating the route.
jules: perfect. Sync tomorrow 10:30 to review API shapes and audit format. Closing note: every change must write a security-audit event with actor, before/after, and ticket id. :white_check_mark:
